name: next-compass
description: Four next-instruction predictions in four directions, plus a colored meaning map to send the in-between

keyMode.title: Key mode
keyMode.description: number: press 1-4 in the empty prompt box. arrow: lay the four choices out as a cross and pick them with the arrow keys after focusing the band (ctrl+x tab or a click).

choiceMode.title: How the four are made
choiceMode.description: split: two parallel calls, one per axis (forward/back, widen/harden), for speed. single: one call that also picks the axes freely each turn (slower).

generator.title: Generator
generator.description: Model that writes the choices. haiku is cheap and reads the recent messages; fork asks the session's own model over the whole conversation (more accurate, uses the prompt cache).

showMap.title: Show the meaning map
showMap.description: Open the meaning map pane at session start (it docks beside the transcript in a wide fullscreen terminal).

extraCount.title: Extra candidates on the map
extraCount.description: How many candidates besides the four to place on the map (0-16).
